**Ayala Malls Manila Bay** is a large, modern shopping mall located in **Paranaque City, Metro Manila, Philippines**. It is part of the **Ayala Malls** chain, owned by **Ayala Land**, one of the country’s leading real estate developers. Here’s everything you need to know about the mall:

---

### **📍 Location & Accessibility**
- **Address:** **Macapagal Boulevard corner Aseana Avenue, Entertainment City, Paranaque City, Metro Manila**
- **Nearby Landmarks:**
  - **City of Dreams Manila** (casino & entertainment complex)
  - **Solaire Resort & Casino**
  - **Okada Manila**
  - **SM Mall of Asia (MOA)** (~5-10 min drive)
  - **NAIA Terminal 3** (~15 min drive)
- **Accessibility:**
  - **By Car:** Easily accessible via **Macapagal Boulevard** or **Aseana Avenue**.
  - **By Public Transport:**
    - **Jeepneys & Buses:** From **EDSA-Taft**, take a bus or jeepney going to **SM MOA** or **Entertainment City**.
    - **Ride-Hailing (Grab, Gojek):** Convenient option.
    - **Future MRT-7 Extension:** Planned to connect to the area (long-term).

---

### **🏢 Mall Overview**
- **Developer:** **Ayala Land (Ayala Malls)**
- **Opening Date:** **September 20, 2019**
- **Gross Floor Area:** **~130,000 sqm**
- **Floors:** **4 levels (including basement parking)**
- **Parking:** **Multi-level basement & open parking (paid, with EV charging stations)**
- **Design Concept:** **Modern, open-air layout with a "bayfront lifestyle" theme**, featuring wide walkways, al fresco dining, and a **rooftop garden**.

---

### **🛍️ Shopping & Retail**
Ayala Malls Manila Bay offers a mix of **local and international brands**, catering to mid-to-high-end shoppers. Key stores include:

#### **👗 Fashion & Apparel**
- **Uniqlo** (flagship store)
- **H&M**
- **Zara**
- **Mango**
- **Bench**
- **Penshoppe**
- **GAP**
- **Old Navy**
- **The SM Store** (department store)
- **Rustan’s** (high-end department store)

#### **👟 Sports & Lifestyle**
- **Nike**
- **Adidas**
- **Puma**
- **Decathlon** (large store)
- **Toby’s Sports**

#### **💄 Beauty & Personal Care**
- **Watsons**
- **The Face Shop**
- **Innisfree**
- **MAC Cosmetics**
- **Sephora** (inside Rustan’s)

#### **📱 Gadgets & Electronics**
- **Digital Walker**
- **Beyond the Box**
- **Globe & Smart stores**

#### **🛋️ Home & Furniture**
- **Our Home**
- **Mandaue Foam**
- **Pottery Barn** (inside Rustan’s)

#### **🎁 Specialty & Concept Stores**
- **Toy Kingdom**
- **National Book Store**
- **Fully Booked**
- **Miniso**
- **Daiso Japan**

---

### **🍽️ Dining & Restaurants**
The mall has a **diverse food scene**, from **fast food to fine dining**, including:

#### **🍔 Fast Food & Casual Dining**
- **Jollibee**
- **McDonald’s**
- **KFC**
- **Burger King**
- **Chowking**
- **Mang Inasal**
- **Shakey’s**

#### **🍜 Asian Cuisine**
- **Din Tai Fung** (Taiwanese)
- **Ramen Nagi** (Japanese)
- **Yakimix** (Japanese-Korean BBQ)
- **Crisostomo** (Filipino-Spanish)
- **Lugang Café** (Taiwanese)
- **Banapple** (Filipino comfort food)

#### **🍕 Western & International**
- **Italianni’s**
- **Friday’s**
- **The Wholesome Table** (healthy options)
- **California Pizza Kitchen**
- **Texas Roadhouse**

#### **☕ Cafés & Desserts**
- **Starbucks** (multiple branches)
- **The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf**
- **Bo’s Coffee**
- **Krispy Kreme**
- **Baskin Robbins**
- **Happy Lemon**
- **Coco Ichibanya** (Japanese curry)

#### **🍷 Bars & Nightlife**
- **The Beer Keg** (craft beer)
- **Z Hostel Rooftop Bar** (nearby, not inside the mall)
- **Wine Story** (wine bar)

#### **🍽️ Unique Dining Experiences**
- **Manam** (modern Filipino)
- **Sars Kitchen + Bar** (Filipino comfort food)
- **The Food Hall** (gourmet food court)

---

### **🎬 Entertainment & Leisure**
- **Cinema:** **Ayala Malls Cinemas** (with **Director’s Club** premium theaters)
- **Arcade:** **Timezone** (family entertainment center)
- **Bowling:** **Paeng’s Bowling & Billiards**
- **Karaoke:** **Music 21**
- **Kids’ Play Area:** **Fun Ranch** (indoor playground)
- **Events & Exhibits:** The mall hosts **concerts, pop-up markets, and seasonal events** (e.g., Christmas displays).

---

### **🏨 Nearby Hotels & Accommodations**
Since the mall is in **Entertainment City**, many **casino hotels** are nearby:
- **Solaire Resort & Casino** (5-min walk)
- **City of Dreams Manila** (5-min walk)
  - **Nüwa Manila**
  - **Hyatt Regency**
  - **Crown Towers**
- **Okada Manila** (10-min drive)
- **Red Planet Aseana** (budget option)

---

### **💰 Services & Amenities**
- **Banks & ATMs:** BPI, BDO, Metrobank, UnionBank, etc.
- **Money Changers**
- **Clinics & Pharmacies:** **Mercury Drug, South Star Drug, Healthway Clinic**
- **Salons & Spas:** **David’s Salon, Fix Salon, Nailaholics**
- **Laundry Services**
- **Pet-Friendly Areas** (some outdoor spaces allow pets)
- **Free Wi-Fi**

---

### **🎉 Events & Promos**
Ayala Malls Manila Bay frequently hosts:
- **Seasonal Sales** (e.g., **3.3, 6.6, 9.9, 12.12 Sales**)
- **Concerts & Performances** (outdoor stage area)
- **Food Festivals** (e.g., **Ayala Malls Food Festival**)
- **Art Exhibits & Pop-Up Markets**
- **New Year & Christmas Displays** (one of the best in Metro Manila)

---
### **⭐ Why Visit Ayala Malls Manila Bay?**
✅ **Strategic Location** – Near **airports, casinos, and MOA**.
✅ **Wide Shopping & Dining Options** – From **luxury to budget-friendly**.
✅ **Modern & Spacious Design** – Less crowded than **MOA or Glorietta**.
✅ **Great for Families** – **Play areas, cinemas, and open spaces**.
✅ **Nightlife & Entertainment** – Close to **casinos and bars**.
✅ **Scenic Views** – **Manila Bay sunset views** from some restaurants.

---
### **⚠️ Things to Note**
- **Parking Fees:** ~₱50 for the first 3 hours, additional charges after.
- **Peak Hours:** **Weekends & holidays** can get crowded.
- **Nearby Traffic:** **Macapagal Boulevard** can have heavy traffic, especially near **MOA and casinos**.
- **Security:** High due to proximity to **casinos and government areas**.

---
### **📸 Instagram-Worthy Spots**
📍 **The Grand Atrium** (central open space with high ceiling)
📍 **Rooftop Garden** (great for **Manila Bay sunset views**)
📍 **Christmas & Holiday Displays** (seasonal)
📍 **Al Fresco Dining Area** (outdoor seating with a relaxed vibe)

---
### **🚗 Best Time to Visit**
- **Weekdays (Monday-Thursday)** – Less crowded.
- **Early Mornings (10 AM - 12 PM)** – Easier parking.
- **Evenings (6 PM onwards)** – Best for **dinner and sunset views**.

---
### **📞 Contact Information**
- **Website:** [Ayala Malls Manila Bay](https://www.ayalamalls.com.ph/malls/manila-bay/)
- **Facebook:** [Ayala Malls Manila Bay](https://www.facebook.com/AyalaMallsManilaBay/)
- **Phone:** +63 (2) 8808 4637
- **Operating Hours:**
  - **Mall Hours:** **10:00 AM – 10:00 PM** (may vary per store)
  - **Cinema & Restaurants:** Some open until **12 MN or later**

---
### **🔜 Future Developments**
- **Expansion Plans:** Possible **new wings or outdoor areas**.
- **More Dining & Retail:** New brands may open in the coming years.
- **Better Public Transport Links:** Future **MRT/Bus connections** to Entertainment City.

---
### **💭 Final Verdict**
Ayala Malls Manila Bay is a **premium shopping destination** with a **relaxed, open-air vibe**, making it a great alternative to **SM Mall of Asia**. It’s ideal for:
✔ **Shopaholics** (wide brand selection)
✔ **Foodies** (diverse dining options)
✔ **Families** (kid-friendly areas)
✔ **Tourists** (near hotels & casinos)
✔ **Date Nights** (romantic rooftop dining)

If you're in **Paranaque or near Manila Bay**, this mall is **worth a visit**!
